title: Colorectal cancer screening, adults aged 45 to 49 years

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for colorectal cancer in adults aged 45 to 49 years.

action: Screen for colorectal cancer using one of the Table 1 strategies: annual high-sensitivity gFOBT or FIT, sDNA-FIT every 1 to 3 years, colonoscopy every 10 years, CT colonography every 5 years, flexible sigmoidoscopy every 5 years, or flexible sigmoidoscopy every 10 years plus annual FIT.

any.note: Covers the High-sensitivity gFOBT and FIT rows, both annual; the fobt concept covers gFOBT or FIT.
